title: HubSpot Lays Off 7% of Workforce, Says It’s Not Because of AI
text:
Software provider HubSpot is laying off 660 employees, or 7% of its staff, as part of a restructuring that will include eliminating some management layers and reorganizing product teams, CEO Yamini Rangan announced in a blog post.
